name: akbai-delivery
description: AKBai product delivery plugin — 12 role-based AI skills and 15 slash commands for building, launching, and operating AKBai (Filipino MSME AI business partner).
author: Anton del Rosario

sprint.description: Generate sprint plan with 3-5 tasks sized for 10-15 hrs

standup.description: Generate weekly standup: GitHub comment + build-in-public post

gap-check.description: Review gap registry status, flag overdue items, recommend priorities

retro.description: Sprint retrospective with structured action items

build.description: End-to-end feature build: ADR → schema → code → tests

review.description: Dual code review: quality + security with severity ratings

test.description: Generate test suite (Jest/Playwright) for specified feature

sense-check.description: 8-signal Sense Check Gate assessment for phase transitions

schema.description: View, add, migrate, or validate Supabase schema

prompt.description: Create or iterate Claude API system prompts with versioning

copy.description: Write Taglish UI copy with tone variants and persona checks

compliance.description: NPC, BIR, or security compliance audit with action items

metrics.description: MRR dashboard, trend analysis, highest-leverage recommendation

notes: 12 skills + 15 commands complete. All commands include shared context loading, step-by-step workflows, and cross-skill delegation.
